headline: OpenAI adds College Planner to ChatGPT for Teens in the US
dek: The tool gathers deadlines, requirements and aid steps for US high schoolers, according to OpenAI.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: A planner for college applications
body: OpenAI is adding College Planner to ChatGPT for Teens, a tool for managing college applications. The company says it brings each school's deadlines, requirements and financial-aid steps into one place (OpenAI).

The first version covers US students in grades 10 through 12 who plan to attend a four-year college. OpenAI says it will expand to more countries and to two-year, technical and trade schools "over time," with no timeline (OpenAI).

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: A list, a timeline and questions
s3.body: Per OpenAI, students build a list of schools and follow a timeline of what is left at each one (OpenAI).

points.t: The tool can explain a requirement or how to get started, OpenAI says (OpenAI).
It helps with aid requirements, aid deadlines, scholarships and fee waivers, according to the company (OpenAI).
OpenAI says the tool handles logistics, while human advisers help students weigh options (OpenAI).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Teen use, as OpenAI describes it
body: OpenAI says teens spend under 15 minutes a day on ChatGPT on average, and fewer than 2% spend more than three consecutive hours. The figures come from the company, not an outside study (OpenAI).
The company also says nearly 1.2 million teens used Learning Visualizations in one week, and more than 180,000 used Study Mode, which walks through problems step by step (OpenAI).

s5.label: What comes next
s5.title: Funding, a lab and open dates

items.t: OpenAI says it will fund College Advising Corps, which places recent graduates as advisers in under-resourced schools (OpenAI).
Boston Children's Hospital's Digital Wellness Lab will gather about 22 students; OpenAI says their feedback will shape teen safety defaults (OpenAI).
OpenAI has not said when College Planner might reach students outside the US (OpenAI).

caption.hook: OpenAI adds College Planner to ChatGPT for Teens, a tool for US high schoolers applying to college.
body: According to OpenAI, ChatGPT for Teens is the default experience applied automatically to accounts identified as belonging to someone under 18. It says the product includes built-in reminders to take a break.

OpenAI also says nearly half of teens who get a break reminder take a break or end the conversation within five minutes. It says the support for Boston Children's Hospital's Digital Wellness Lab will run three years. The figures are the company's own.
OpenAI says the planner handles logistics, while human advisers help students decide.
caption.cta: Which parts of the college application process should an AI tool handle, and which should stay with human advisers?
